title: Overheating issues
body: It’s happened before but now it’s becoming a reoccurring problem, even after short use it makes my iPad heat up very much and the app lags because of it.   It does happen with other apps. Otherwise I love it and don’t want to switch to another app. Please optimize it better

title: Top Pick
body: Pleasure to use. Great for everyday note taking. I go for Notion for Business purposess and collaborations, as they offer more customization but I still find myself reaching for the native apple apps when it comes to most personal notes because of their simple interface and ease of use.
